{{Current events|year=2019|month=05|day=27|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Law enforcement in France|French police]] arrest four people in connection with last Friday's bombing in [[Lyon]]'s historic city center that injured 13 people. Anti-terrorist prosecutors are leading the investigation. [[2nd arrondissement of Lyon|District mayor]] Denis Broliquier said the bomb was a relatively weak explosive that was too small to kill. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48420490 (BBC)]
*Over Sunday and Monday, 55 people die of asphyxiation in various prisons across the [[Brazil]]ian city of [[Manaus]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48420484 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*Italian firm [[Fiat Chrysler Automobiles|Fiat Chrysler]]  proposes a merger with French carmaker [[Renault]]. The new company will be based in the [[Netherlands]] and will be listed on the [[Borsa Italiana|Milan]], [[Paris Bourse|Paris]] and [[New York Stock Exchange|New York]] stock exchanges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48420334 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 45 people die when a boat sinks on [[Lake Mai-Ndombe]] in western [[Democratic Republic of Congo]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48421344 (BBC)]
*Eight miners die in a goldmine explosion in central [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-48419494 (BBC)]
* An airplane crashes in [[Sergipe]], Brazil, killing Brazilian singer [[Gabriel Diniz]]. [https://g1.globo.com/se/sergipe/noticia/2019/05/27/corpo-de-bombeiros-e-acionado-para-atender-acidente-envolvendo-queda-de-bimotor.ghtml (G1)]
*[[Tornadoes of 2019|U.S. tornadoes of 2019]]
**Multiple destructive tornadoes strike [[Dayton, Ohio]], and surrounding communities. There was at least one known fatality in [[Celina, Ohio|Celina]]. Multiple homes and businesses were destroyed, with reports of numerous power outages and a boil and water conservation advisory issued for Dayton. [https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/large-destructive-tornado-strikes-dayton-as-severe-storms-ravage-ohio/70008380 (Accuweather)]

;Law and crime
* [[Romania]]'s [[High Court of Cassation and Justice|Supreme Court]] denies  [[Social Democratic Party (Romania)|Social Democratic Party]] leader [[Liviu Dragnea]]'s appeal of his conviction and three-and-a-half year prison sentence for corruption. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48421430 (BBC)]
*[[Amazonas prison massacres]]
**[[Brazil]] prison officials report at least 42 prisoners are found strangled to death in four separate jails in the state of [[Amazonas (Brazilian state)|Amazonas]]. Yesterday, 15 prisoners were killed in a fight between rival prison gangs at a facility near the Amazonas capital [[Manaus]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-violence-prisons/brazil-officials-find-42-prisoners-dead-in-amazonas-state-after-deadly-gang-clash-idUSKCN1SX1WM?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/clashes-between-prisoners-in-brazils-amazonas-claim-15-lives-authorities-say-victims-were-killed-with-sharpened-toothbrushes-6706231.html (''Firstpost'')]
;Politics and elections 
*[[2019 Austrian legislative election]]
**[[Chancellor of Austria|Austrian Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] loses a no-confidence vote following a corruption [[Ibiza affair|scandal]] over a secret video. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-europe-48422732 (BBC)] 
*[[2019 Malawian general election]]
**[[Peter Mutharika]] of the [[Democratic Progressive Party (Malawi)|Democratic Progressive Party]] wins Malawi's May 21 presidential election with 39% of the vote, followed by [[Lazarus Chakwera]] of the [[Malawi Congress Party]] with 36% and [[Saulos Chilima]] of the United Democratic Movement with 20%. [https://www.reuters.com/us-malawi-election/malawi's-mutharika-narrowly-wins-presidential-race-with-38-57-of-the-vote-idUSKCN1SX1KU (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Canadian federal election]]
**In separate press conferences, former Liberal cabinet members [[Jody Wilson-Raybould]] and [[Jane Philpott]], who both resigned over the government's handling of the [[SNC-Lavalin affair|SNC-Lavalin criminal case]], announce they are  running as independents in the October 2019 elections. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48360557?intlink_from_url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world/us_and_canada&link_location=live-reporting-story (BBC)]
